integrity: The exact lattice and counts have a complete proof, with small-case exhaustive and nonabelian construction checks; computation is not used to infer the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Finite groups, one absorbing zero, and ordinary semigroup-compatible reflexive relations only. The DSC coefficient does not distinguish finite groups with equal numbers of normal subgroups; historical priority outside inspected literature is unverified.
title: The diagonal-relation lattice of a finite group with adjoined zero
